info.title: How to Encourage a Hearing Test
info.subtitle: Five gentle steps from first concern to a booked appointment

rows.title: Notice the signs
rows.desc: Jot down specific, recent moments to point to

rows.title: Choose a calm moment
rows.desc: Private, unhurried, not right after a mishear

rows.title: Lead with connection
rows.desc: Say 'I miss talking with you,' not 'you can't hear'

rows.title: Make it easy
rows.desc: Offer to book, drive, and sit in on the visit

rows.title: Book it together
rows.desc: Pin down a real date so it stops being someday
